strings.Select every download in this list (clic: 選擇此列表中的所有下載(再次點選取消選擇)
strings.Remove the selected downloads from the l: 從列表中移除所選下載
strings.Remove finished downloads from the list: 從列表中移除已完成的下載
strings.Download files from a website section: 下載網站某個部分的檔案
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: 點選“新增網址”,貼上連結,將連結拖到此視窗,或透過擴充套件從瀏覽器下載。
strings.Delete and Move File to Recycle Bin…: 刪除並將檔案移到回收站…
strings.Delete and Move File to Trash…: 刪除並將檔案移到垃圾桶…
strings.The new language is used after the app r: 新語言會在應用程式重新啟動後使用。
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: 下載、影片和種子只使用此介面卡（例如你的 VPN）。如果它中斷，下載會停止，而不會改用其他連線。
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: 種子封鎖清單：檔案或 https:// 位址（留空 = 無）
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: 種子絕不會連線到此清單中的位址。支援 P2P、DAT 和 CIDR 清單，也支援 .gz。位址每天重新下載一次。
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: 封鎖清單位址必須以 https:// 開頭
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: 這些訂閱的新項目在標題符合規則時自動下載：檔案和影片，開啟種子後也包括種子。規則是標題中必須全部出現的字詞，或 /正規表示式/。
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: 下載標題包含以下所有字詞的項目（留空 = 全部）
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: 略過標題包含以下任一字詞的項目
strings.Only download items that appear after th: 只下載新增訂閱之後出現的項目
strings.The feed address must start with http://: 訂閱位址必須以 http:// 或 https:// 開頭
strings.The rule's regular expression is not val: 規則的正規表示式無效。
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: 我使用電腦時，將下載限制為 KB/s（0 = 關閉）
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: 一分鐘沒有鍵盤或滑鼠操作後恢復全速。
strings.Your API key for the service: 你的服務 API 金鑰
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: 經由該服務的網站（以逗號分隔，例如 example-host.com）
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: 預設關閉。使用你自己的帳戶；其他網站的連結絕不會傳送給該服務。金鑰加密儲存，不會放入備份。
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Download limit: at most this many MB (0 = no limit)
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: When the amount is reached, downloads stop and continue by themselves when the next period starts.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Enter the proxy script's web address (http:// or https://) or the full path of the file.
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Proxy address (for a proxy script: its web address or file)
strings.Put each package in its own folder: Put each package in its own folder
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Unpack a package's archives when all of it is done
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Paste text with links, or a web page address and press Find Links. Parts of a split archive are grouped into one package.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Save the whole gallery with the gallery engine (sites like Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; the engine is downloaded the first time)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Start the Add window in the folder I used last time
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Wake the computer from sleep to start
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options must allow wake timers. The app has to be running (it can be in the tray).
strings.Getting the gallery engine (only the fir: Getting the gallery engine (only the first time)…
strings.Getting the video engine (only the first: Getting the video engine (only the first time)…
